title: International Summer School (ISS)
field: Bachelor's and master's level summer courses
about: The University of Oslo International Summer School in Norway offers bachelor's and master's level summer courses starting 28 June 2027. The application portal opens 4 January 2027; scholarship applicants apply by 25 January 2027 and self-financed applicants by 1 March 2027.
card_alt: Card for the International Summer School (ISS) at the University of Oslo in Oslo, Norway; deadline for self-financed applicants 1 Mar 2027. The photo shows the Bryggen waterfront in Bergen, Norway, not Oslo.
